items.title: Sheryl Bailey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 24, 2023
items.q: “You know what Monk said?” I said, “What, teacher.” And he said, “The hippest thing I ever did was lay out.”

ctx.x: Me too. You know one time when I was a kid, and I’m sure it’s cause I was just mindlessly clomping away, but my teacher said — this was in my first ensemble in
Pittsburgh as a kid — he’s staring at me, he goes, “You know what Monk said?” I said, “What, teacher.” And he said, “The hippest thing I ever did was lay out.”
I think Chick Corea said that too. He said if you can’t hear it then don’t play or something like that. I mean silence is — I think of it as a sound of its own I guess.
